# CLI reference

Every command of `agent-events`, generated from the CLI itself.

The CLI needs no MCP server and no agent. Install `@agentcomms/events-daemon` and run it.

```bash
npx -y @agentcomms/events-daemon <command>          # without installing
npm i -g @agentcomms/events-daemon && agent-events   # or on the PATH
```

`<angle brackets>` are required, `[square brackets]` optional, `<name...>` repeats. Every command takes
`--json` for a machine-readable envelope, and `--no-color` to drop ANSI codes.

## Exit codes

Scripts should read these rather than parse output.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | it worked |
| `1` | unexpected failure |
| `10` | a local service action needs a person or is unavailable |
| `64` | the command was used wrongly |
| `65` | the data given was not usable |
| `66` | what was asked for does not exist |
| `69` | the local service is unavailable |
| `75` | temporary; retrying later is reasonable |
| `77` | a local permission is needed |
| `78` | a local service configuration problem, including a Node older than 22.16, which has no complete `node:sqlite` |

## Commands

| Command | What it is for |
|---|---|
| [`status`](#agent-events-status) | report whether the local event service has an owner |
| [`run`](#agent-events-run) | start the foreground local event owner until it receives a clean stop request |
| [`stop`](#agent-events-stop) | ask the foreground owner to stop cleanly |
| [`pause`](#agent-events-pause) | pause polling, evaluation and delivery claims without purging state |
| [`resume`](#agent-events-resume) | resume operational work retained by pause |
| [`disable-all`](#agent-events-disable-all) | disable collection, advance the global generation and purge B1 work |
| [`enable-all`](#agent-events-enable-all) | report the standing approval required before collection can be enabled |
| [`doctor`](#agent-events-doctor) | report content-free lineage, retry, recovery, judge authority, hold-clock and global switch health |
| [`approval`](#agent-events-approval) | view the authoritative pending disclosure approval |
| [`catalogue`](#agent-events-catalogue) | inspect the local event catalogue |
| [`sources`](#agent-events-sources) | inspect configured event sources |
| [`source`](#agent-events-source) | inspect one configured event source |
| [`rules`](#agent-events-rules) | inspect immutable local event rule versions |
| [`rule`](#agent-events-rule) | create, inspect and control immutable event rules |
| [`targets`](#agent-events-targets) | inspect immutable local event target versions |
| [`target`](#agent-events-target) | create, inspect and revoke immutable dry-run targets |
| [`subscribers`](#agent-events-subscribers) | inspect immutable SSE subscriber versions |
| [`subscriber`](#agent-events-subscriber) | create, update, and revoke immutable SSE subscribers |
| [`judges`](#agent-events-judges) | inspect immutable content-free judge metadata |
| [`judge`](#agent-events-judge) | manage immutable judges and run fixed synthetic tests |
| [`budget`](#agent-events-budget) | inspect or prepare the immutable global judge budget |
| [`provider`](#agent-events-provider) | the providers whose keys the event service keeps — TypeSafe, OpenRouter and Anthropic for Jev and Analyse, Linear for a Linear target — and whether each has a key |
| [`collection`](#agent-events-collection) | the event service watching your accounts: switched on by the approval enable-all prepares, off at once with disable-all |
| [`integration`](#agent-events-integration) | the services a rule can act in — Linear, and agent-sessions (your claude-stream relay) — and what each can see (a person only) |
| [`session-queue`](#agent-events-session-queue) | the matches waiting for a busy agent session, each passed on when the session’s run ends |
| [`deliveries`](#agent-events-deliveries) | inspect content-free delivery metadata |
| [`delivery`](#agent-events-delivery) | show, retry or drop one exact delivery |
| [`held`](#agent-events-held) | inspect typed held decisions |
| [`dryrun`](#agent-events-dryrun) | read the dry-run log: what a dry-run target would have delivered, kept 24 hours at most |
| [`queue`](#agent-events-queue) | work through the action queue: what matched your queue rules, and what you have done with it |
| [`lane`](#agent-events-lane) | bind a lane — a queue your rules send to — to the one agent window woken for its items, and unbind it |
| [`messages`](#agent-events-messages) | what happened to each message the event service observed: matched, judged, delivered, queued, read |
| [`message`](#agent-events-message) | one message the event service observed, by its event id |
| [`approve`](#agent-events-approve) | approve a standing disclosure by typing its challenge at this terminal, after optional target tests |
| [`mcp`](#agent-events-mcp) | serve the MCP interface over standard input and output |
| [`secrets`](#agent-events-secrets) | migrate the daemon-owned secret backend at a human terminal |

### `agent-events integration show`

linear: whether a key is kept, its workspace and teams (with --team, that team’s labels); agent-sessions: where the relay is and whether it is ready

```
agent-events integration show [options] <integration>
```

| Option | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--team <key>` | linear: a team, by its key (such as CUE) or its id, whose labels to list | — |

### `agent-events integration set`

set where the relay is, or a folder a file part may be read from (a person, at a terminal or in the app)

```
agent-events integration set [options] <integration>
```

| Option | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--relay-home <path>` | the relay's home folder, where its control.token is; default for the defaults | — |
| `--relay-port <port>` | the relay's port; default for the Pilot app's record, else 4318 | — |
| `--allow-folder <path>` | a folder a session’s file parts may be read from (repeat for more) | `[]` |
| `--remove-folder <path>` | a folder to take off that list (repeat for more) | `[]` |
